# XLSX fixtures for the spreadsheet editor

Generated by `python3 tools/xlsx-fixtures/make_fixtures.py` (openpyxl, fixed seeds, byte-reproducible). Upload to a running example app with `tools/xlsx-fixtures/upload.sh <base-url>`.

- `c01-sales-report.xlsx` - 4 sheets with tab colours; 120-row Excel Table (TableStyleMedium2), currency/date/percent formats, freeze panes, data bars, 3-colour scale, cellIs and icon-set rules; Summary with SUMIF/VLOOKUP/IF/ROUND/TODAY, bar, line and pie charts; defined names, merged title, borders, comments, external and internal hyperlinks.
- `c02-gradebook.xlsx` - 30 students x 8 assessments; AVERAGE/MAX/MIN/RANK/IF letter grades; colour scale, formula-based and cellIs rules; list and whole-number data validation; column chart; landscape print setup, fit to 1 page wide, print titles, header/footer.
- `c03-budget.xlsx` - association budget with 12 month columns; SUM totals, % of total, red negative number format, hidden column B, outlined (grouped) rows, line chart; "Notes" sheet with wrapped long text.
- `c04-blank-ish.xlsx` - minimal sheet for keyboard tests: numbers A1:A5, text B1:B5, =A1*2 in C1, =SUM(A1:A5) in A6.
- `c05-pivot-source.xlsx` - 200-row flat Table (Date/Category/Region/Salesperson/Amount) to build a PivotTable from.
